CheckTitle: NAT Gateway DNAT rules do not expose sensitive ports to the internet
Description: This check verifies that NAT Gateway DNAT rules do not expose sensitive ports (SSH, RDP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, MSSQL) to the internet.
Risk: Exposing sensitive ports via DNAT rules allows direct internet access to internal services, increasing the attack surface and risk of unauthorized access.

Recommendation.Text: Remove DNAT rules that expose sensitive ports or restrict access using security groups.
